== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ホス：エコー基地医務室</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja">１ターンに１回、自分の医療用ドロイドを１台、－２で配備できる。</span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">ここを支配しており、この場所に帝国軍がいるなら、フォース消耗に＋１。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Hoth: Echo Med Lab]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — Light Side. Once per turn, one of your medical droids may deploy for 2 less. Dark Side. If you control this site and an Imperial is at this place, Force drain is +1.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Title is エコー基地医務室. Light uses １台 for one medical droid. Dark uses この場所に帝国軍がいるなら where English says “with an Imperial present”. One Light Force icon, no Dark Force icons.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-hothechomedlab-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Hoth: Echo Med Lab]].</ref>
